mode.description:
defines  what the points represent
If mode is 'Points',  we plot them as points.
If mode is 'Polyline', we draw a path using this points in order.
If mode is 'Polygon', we draw a path using this points in order, looping back at the end.

Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

title:
A Location organizes resource consuming assets in a way so as to produce
commercial or social value. Location is where an Asset is in space.
Location is only of interest because it holds some assets at some point of
time either in the past, present or future.
Locations can vary in levels of granularity: a Location could be a campus,
facility or plant but it could also be a room or a floor in a building.
Thus Locations can contain or be contained in other Locations. However, a
granular Location can never be contained in more than one higher level
Location. Thus Locations can be organized into a strict hierarchy but
cannot be part of a M:M recursion: a building cannot be part of two
different campuses and a floor cannot be part of two different buildings.
How is a building Location different from a Fixed Asset building? A
building Location is only about the place of the building in space. If we
want to know facts such as the size of the building, we would find that
building as a Fixed Asset.
